set_all_non_lazy_fields: set all non-lazy fields on a protobuf TestAllTypes message to unique test values
set_all_fields: set all fields including lazy ones on a protobuf message to unique test values
set_all_extensions: set all extension fields on a protobuf TestAllExtensions message to unique test values
expect_all_fields_set: verify all fields of a protobuf message have the expected values after SetAllFields
set_all_packed_fields: set all packed repeated fields on a protobuf TestPackedTypes message to unique test values
